design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (paycheck_advance_servicing). Step 0 draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6, 6]; the relief takes 6 factors, the largest advance takes 6.
SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Occupied before: nothing (first task). Claimed here: advance_ext_payroll_delay_relief (agent, state_due, tool grant_payroll_delay_relief_50112cf3, subject advance_fee_waiver) and advance_ext_largest_advance (user, on_request, tool request_advance_00c9f515, subject advance_disbursement). Left for task 1: late-fee assessment (subject advance_fee) and the customer's debit-card repayment (subject advance_repayment), a disjoint tree on a past-due line, with its own tools; nothing else is reserved.
WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer asks one thing: the largest advance she can take now to her bank debit card. The number is a six-factor computation (payroll bonus from the last month's direct deposits in the personal account, plan bonus from the Onyx plan, line-tenure bonus, borrowing-track bonus, a late-fee holdback and a card multiplier) and it is worked out only after a relief the customer never mentions: her June advance was collected 18 days late from a delayed payroll deposit and its 3.00 late fee qualifies for a payroll-delay relief that is missing from the ledger. The agent must read the largest-advance rule's prerequisite sentence, find in the ledger that the relief waiver entry is absent, work out from the relief rule that the relief write is what brings that state about, compute the relief (itself six factors over the ledger, the personal account and the card) and only then compute the advance on the changed world. Difficulty comes from policy reading, ledger reconciliation and arithmetic; there is one tool per problem and no near-synonym tools.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: advance_ext_largest_advance. Edge: largest_advance -> payroll_delay_relief, kind value_input, gate kept_late_fees (compute binding), form state. Prerequisite sentence (in the largest-advance rule): 'The largest advance a line can take is worked out only after every late fee on the line that qualifies for payroll-delay relief carries its relief waiver entry.' Four-point test: (1) ordering connective 'only after', affirmative direction — a desk states that a figure is worked out only after what it rests on is in place; (2) its waited-on side is a record-visible state (a waiver entry standing against a late fee), no action named; (3) no tool, id or snake_case token; (4) strength 'only after', scope 'every late fee on the line that qualifies' — exactly the edge's condition. Exactly one write of the difficulty brings that state about: the relief rule books a waiver with waiver_reason courtesy on the qualifying late fee; no other extended policy writes a waiver. Derivation: sentence + ledger (late fee 62c28762-2464-4ec8-9b5a-c98074a6a6ad of 3.00, advance c9e48306-29b5-485e-a6dd-a586556e6b8b due 2026-06-12, autopay collection ba6ffe85-895a-404d-b2e4-f558afa7d26e on 2026-06-30, no waiver row) + relief rule ('A late fee booked on an advance whose autopay collection came from a direct deposit that posted after the advance's due date is relieved in part by a payroll-delay relief ...') -> the relief write, one reading. Condition false at frozen_time: no advance_fee_waiver row exists on the line. Resolving action grant_payroll_delay_relief_50112cf3 (owner agent), synchronous. Topological order: relief (step 9) then advance request (step 11). No parallel edges. Deletion sensitivity (recomputed): without the relief write the largest advance is 285.0 instead of 305.0 (kept late fees 3.00 -> holdback 40 instead of 20). user_scenario names no fee, waiver or relief; the tools check no prerequisite.
CUSTOMER-OWNED WRITE. request_advance_00c9f515 is owner=user: base advance_disbursement_rules says 'Requesting an advance is the customer's own borrowing decision and is confirmed by the customer in the app.' The agent unlocks it at step 10 and the customer submits it with the figures the agent gives (amount 305.00, due date 2026-10-22, fee 9.00); its receipt (advance reference) is a runtime return, never pre-written in the persona. Delivery is fixed to standard delivery to the external debit card inside the tool, because a personal_balance delivery fires a wallet internal credit (another category) and express would add a fee.
FACTOR CARD — relief (advance_ext_payroll_delay_relief, 5 parameter + 1 method). Baseline paragraph: relief = late fee x standard_share 0.10, rounded, never above the fee -> 0.30. collection_lag: 18 days (2026-06-12 -> 2026-06-30) >= 14 -> +0.20 (baseline gives 1.16). payroll_record (cross wallet, multi-source): 11 direct deposits after 2026-03-24 totalling 12896.85 -> tier 2 +0.05 (near-miss: the 612.00 IRS tax refund dated 2026-03-24 sits on the excluded first day; counting it would make 12 and tier 1). account_age (cross wallet): personal account opened 2022-03-08, 1661 days -> +0.05. lateness_record: at most one late fee in twelve months and 3 advances (near-miss: the 2025-09-24 advance is exactly twelve months back and excluded) -> +0.05. plan_membership (cross wallet): Onyx -> +0.05. card_multiplier (method, cross card, multi-source): three different computations by tier — Platinum and higher multiply the relief by 1.4; Classic/Gold with at least 10 purchases add card_purchase_credit 0.02 per purchase; otherwise the relief is rounded as it stands. Gold Debit physical active, 13 purchases after 2026-06-24 (the 2026-06-24 purchase is excluded) -> 1.50 + 0.26 = 1.76. Per-factor baseline results 1.16 / 1.61 / 1.61 / 1.61 / 1.61 / 1.50, all-baseline 0.30.
FACTOR CARD — largest advance (advance_ext_largest_advance, 5 parameter + 1 method). Baseline paragraph: room = advance_limit 200 less remaining principal 0, rounded down to a multiple of 5 -> 200. payroll_bonus (cross wallet, multi-source): 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-15 deposits, 2250.80 >= 1600 from 2 deposits -> +50 (baseline 255). plan_bonus (cross wallet): Onyx -> +plan_limit_bonus 25 (baseline 280). line_tenure: opened 2023-05-02, 1241 days -> +30 (baseline 275). borrowing_track: 3 advances in twelve months -> +10 (baseline 295). lateness_holdback: kept late fees 3.00 - 1.76 = 1.24 -> -20 (baseline 325; before the relief it would be -40). card_uplift (method, cross card): Platinum and higher multiply the room by 1.10; Classic/Gold with at least 10 purchases add card_purchase_room 1.00 per purchase; otherwise the room is rounded as it stands. Gold, 13 purchases -> 295 + 13 = 308 -> 305 (baseline 295). All-baseline 200.
OVERWRITES (no second product). Relief: replaces the courtesy clause of advance_waivers (request, yearly count) with the automatic payroll-delay relief, and the cancellation-window sentence for this waiver kind; the rule restates what survives of both base sentences (the cancellation-window waiver of flat and express fees; the customer-requested courtesy waiver with its yearly count, which the relief does not use up). Largest advance: replaces three base clauses — the effective-limit definition of advance_agg_outstanding, its cap 'and their remaining principal plus the new advance may not exceed the effective limit.', and advance_disbursement_rules 'The amount is at least min_advance_amount and a whole multiple of advance_increment, within advance_agg_outstanding.' — with the sentences 'The largest advance worked out here takes the place of the effective limit as the ceiling on a new advance ...' and 'The amount of a new advance is at least min_advance_amount, a whole multiple of advance_increment and within the largest advance worked out here, and the count of advances not yet fully repaid plus the new one still may not exceed max_outstanding_advances.' Concurrency, the monthly count, the line_active gate, the minimum amount, increments, delivery and the fee rules stay inherited. The base flat-fee rule is unchanged and gives the 9.00 fee.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 9 (advance_fee_waiver): advance_waivers.waive_once (dedup) — no waiver row points at 62c28762-2464-4ec8-9b5a-c98074a6a6ad -> satisfied; advance_waivers.cancellation_window is retired by the declared overwrite. Step 11 (advance_disbursement): advance_disbursement_rules.line_active — advance_lines status active -> satisfied; advance_agg_outstanding and advance_fees carry no structured gate (policy_scope): no open advance (outstanding 0.00, none disbursed in September, cooldown 12 h long passed since 2026-06-30), external_debit_card is allowed on Standard. No time gate applies to either write, so temporal_feasibility is empty.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Relief object: the late fee row 62c28762-2464-4ec8-9b5a-c98074a6a6ad (source_txn_id -> advance c9e48306-29b5-485e-a6dd-a586556e6b8b); the delay reads that advance's due date and the autopay row ba6ffe85-895a-404d-b2e4-f558afa7d26e; the older advances (2025-09-24, 2025-12-12, 2026-04-03) carry only flat fees and on-time or grace-period collections and are excluded as relief objects. Advance object: the line 5e12072a-d9a4-4078-ba58-3579ff84eca3; the new disbursement and its fee row are created by the tool and linked by source_txn_id.
WORLD ROWS. customers (identity), wallet_accounts (Onyx, opened 2022-03-08, balance 1737.24 = sum of the seeded activity), 44 wallet_transactions (18 direct deposits incl. the payroll change: biweekly 1038.55 until 2026-05-29, nothing until the double 2077.10 on 2026-06-30, then semi-monthly 1125.40; the 2026-03-24 tax refund; nine rent payments, nine Onyx plan fees, eight standard cash-outs), card_accounts (Gold physical), 15 card purchases, advance_lines (Standard, active, past_due_since 2026-06-22), 13 advance_ledger rows. Removing the June late fee kills the relief and the holdback; removing the 2026-06-30 autopay row kills the payroll delay; removing the deposits, the card purchases or the plan moves a factor tier. Automatic clauses checked: no unbooked late-fee period (the June advance was repaid 2026-06-30 before its second period closed), tier reviews consistent (2026-07-01 drop Plus->Standard; no upgrade since, 0 on-time repayments in a row), no cancellation window open, no courtesy request.
PERSONA. Delphine Rourke, brisk dispatcher; volunteers only the surface goal (the most she can borrow now, to her bank debit card) and her mobile number; DOB, SSN last four and email only when asked; the destination card and delivery preference as must-ask answers; the June payroll change only if the agent asks about June, with no fee knowledge; passive consent to anything the agent says must come first; submits the hand-over herself and ends on the advance reference. No template labels, no numbers she could not know.
STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB, SSN4) -> find_advance_lines -> find_advance_ledger -> find_wallet_accounts -> find_wallet_transactions -> find_card_accounts -> find_card_transactions -> unlock + call relief(line, 62c28762-2464-4ec8-9b5a-c98074a6a6ad, 1.76) -> unlock_user + customer calls request_advance(line, 305.00, 2026-10-22, 9.00).
VERIFICATION RUN (executed): check_compute --task 0 recomputes 1.76 at step 9 (world = initial_state) and 305.0 at step 11 (world after the relief); factor sensitivities as listed; all-baseline 0.30 and 200.0; skipping the relief gives 285.0. All per-task gates OK for --task 0; replay closure 76/76 rows.
CLOSURE. policy -> tool -> computation -> GT call: relief -> grant_payroll_delay_relief_50112cf3 -> step 9 amount 1.76; largest advance -> request_advance_00c9f515 -> step 11 amount 305.00. charter_scope and required_documents list both policies in resolution order.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Using only the published rules (relief rule, largest-advance rule, base fee and disbursement rules), the tool schemas, the finder returns and the persona: the rule for her request says it is worked out only after qualifying late fees carry their relief waiver; the ledger shows the June late fee without one and a collection 18 days after the due date; the relief rule gives 0.50 x 3.00 + 13 x 0.02 = 1.76; then the room 295 + 13 = 308 -> 305, which the rule makes the ceiling in place of the base effective limit; fee 9.00, due 2026-10-22. Same writes, order and values as gold.
ROUND 2 REVISION (policy-task audit r1). F-POL-1 symptom: the base cap 'their remaining principal plus the new advance may not exceed the effective limit' and 'within advance_agg_outstanding' were still in force and gave 225 or 200 against 305; root cause: only the effective-limit definition was declared in overwrite; change: both cap clauses declared superseded, with two new rule sentences making the computed largest advance the ceiling; re-run: amount 305 unique. F-FAC-1 symptom: card_multiplier and card_uplift only swapped a multiplier; change: the Classic/Gold tier now adds a per-purchase credit (relief 0.02, room 1.00) while the higher tier multiplies — different formulas; re-run: relief 1.80 -> 1.76 (kept late fees 1.24, same holdback tier), largest advance stays 305, sensitivities 1.16/1.61/1.61/1.61/1.61/1.50 and 255/280/275/295/325/295. F-OBS-4: the lateness-record ladder now says 'at most one late fee in the twelve months', matching compute. F-OBS-2 / F-OBS-6: surviving parts of the superseded waiver sentences restated in the relief rule. Propagated to evaluation_criteria (step 9 amount, tracing), computations, prerequisite_closure, solvability_contract and this dossier.
ROUND 3 REVISION (KB render gate). Symptom: the render gate rejected the relief hub because factor id 'payroll_delay' is a substring of the tool name the hub must carry (grant_payroll_delay_relief_50112cf3). Change: factor id renamed to collection_lag (same bindings, ladder, baseline and figures); every factor-id reference in this task updated. No other factor id is a substring of any tool name or extended policy id (checked).
user_scenario: You are Delphine Rourke, a 37-year-old freight dispatcher in Portland who calls on a short break between loads, so you are friendly but brisk and you like plain answers. You open by saying your car's transmission just went and the shop wants a deposit today, so you want to borrow as much as I'm allowed on my Pocketwire Advance right now, sent to your regular bank debit card; to help them find you, you give your mobile number, 5552653307. You have only the one advance line and nothing on it is owed as far as you know; you have not borrowed since late spring. You do not know what your limit is or what the fee will be, and you never guess a number: if the agent asks how much you want, you say you want the most they can give you today, and when the agent tells you the amount, the fee and the due date, you accept them as long as they explain where they came from. Standard delivery to the card is fine; you do not want to pay extra for express. If the agent asks which card, it is your Oregon Pacific Credit Union debit card ending 5093, already linked to Pocketwire. You give identity details only when asked: your date of birth is 1988-11-19 and the last four of your Social Security number are 5286; your email is delphine.rourke@pw5mail.example if they want it. If the agent says something on your account has to be sorted out before they can work out the advance, you tell them to go ahead and do whatever is needed on their side. If the agent asks about the advance you had in June, you only know that your employer switched payroll companies that month and the paycheck came in far later than usual; you do not know anything about fees or how they are handled. Borrowing is your own decision, so once the agent hands the advance request over to you, you submit it yourself exactly with the figures the agent gave you, then read back the advance reference you get. When you have the advance reference in hand, you thank the agent and end the call; you never ask for anything else.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's customer profile from the mobile number she volunteers.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs her customer reference number; the verification step compares her stated details against this profile.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with three details she states (mobile number, date of birth, SSN last four).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account information may be discussed and no advance booked before identity is verified; the tool needs three matching details.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her advance line: tier Pocketwire Advance Standard, status active, opened 2023-05-02, amount owed 0.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier supplies advance_limit, advance_increment, dd_min_monthly and plan_limit_bonus; the opening date decides the line-tenure bonus; the active status is the disbursement gate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole ledger of the line: four advances with their fees and autopay repayments, the late fee of 3.00 booked 2026-06-29 on the advance due 2026-06-12 that autopay collected from the direct deposit of 2026-06-30, and no waiver entry.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is where the agent discovers the unmet prerequisite: the late fee qualifies for payroll-delay relief (18-day payroll delay) and carries no relief waiver, which the largest-advance rule waits on; it also feeds the payroll delay, the lateness record, the late fees kept, the borrowing track (three advances in twelve months, the 2025-09-24 advance falling outside) and the remaining principal.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the linked personal account: plan Pocketwire Onyx, opened 2022-03-08, active.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The plan decides the relief plan share and the plan bonus on the room; the opening date decides the account-age share of the relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the personal-account activity, in particular every direct deposit and its date.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The six-month direct deposit count and total (11 deposits, the 2026-03-24 tax refund falling outside the window) decide the relief payroll-record share, and the last month's deposits (2026-08-31 and 2026-09-15) decide the payroll bonus on the room.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her Pocketwire Visa card: Gold Debit, physical, active.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The card tier chooses which card treatment the relief and the room take.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the card activity and count the purchases in the three months before the handling date (13; the 2026-06-24 purchase falls outside).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: At least ten purchases in that window is the second condition of the card treatment tiers used by both computations, and on the Classic/Gold tier the number of purchases itself enters the relief and the room.
First half of the unlock/call pair for the relief; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the payroll-delay relief of 1.76 as a courtesy waiver on the 3.00 late fee of the advance due 2026-06-12; the line then shows a credit of 1.76.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: advance_ext_payroll_delay_relief computes the relief amount; the largest-advance rule is worked out only after this relief waiver entry stands, and it lowers the late fees kept from 3.00 to 1.24.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.advance_line_id: Value 5e12072a-d9a4-4078-ba58-3579ff84eca3. Basis: the tool docstring says 'the reference number of the customer's advance line, as returned by the advance line lookup', and find_advance_lines(customer_id) returns exactly one line for Delphine Rourke (initial_state.advance_lines.5e12072a-d9a4-4078-ba58-3579ff84eca3). Uniqueness: she holds one line; no other advance line row exists for her customer id.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_txn_id: Value 62c28762-2464-4ec8-9b5a-c98074a6a6ad. Basis: the relief rule says 'The relief acts on the late fee most recently booked on the line.' and the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the late fee entry being relieved, as returned by the advance activity lookup for that line'; find_advance_ledger returns a single advance_fee row with fee_type late_fee (3.00, 2026-06-29, fee_period 1) on the advance due 2026-06-12. Uniqueness: every other fee row on the line is a flat advance fee (fee_type advance_fee), which the relief never touches, so any correct agent passes this one late fee row.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 1.76. late_fee_amount = 3.00 (the 2026-06-29 late fee); collection_lag: due 2026-06-12 to autopay collection 2026-06-30 = 18 days >= 14 -> +0.20; payroll_record: 11 direct deposits after 2026-03-24 totalling 12896.85 (fewer than 12, at least 6 and at least 2400) -> +0.05; account_age: personal account opened 2022-03-08, 1661 days >= 1095 -> +0.05; lateness_record: at most one late fee in twelve months and 3 advances -> +0.05; plan_membership: Pocketwire Onyx -> +0.05; relief share 0.10 + 0.40 = 0.50; 3.00 x 0.50 = 1.50; card treatment: Gold Debit with 13 purchases in three months -> card_purchase_credit 0.02 per purchase is added: 1.50 + 13 x 0.02 = 1.76, rounded 1.76; never more than 3.00 -> 1.76. Any agent applying the published rule to these rows lands on 1.76; skipping a factor gives 1.16, 1.61 or 1.50 instead.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's advance request and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Requesting an advance is the customer's own borrowing decision; the agent unlocks it for her; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer requests the new advance of 305.00 with its flat fee of 9.00 and due date 2026-10-22, delivered by standard delivery to her external debit card.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: advance_ext_largest_advance computes the amount on the world after the relief; the flat fee and the due date follow the base fee and disbursement rules.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.advance_line_id: Value 5e12072a-d9a4-4078-ba58-3579ff84eca3. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the customer's advance line, as returned by the advance line lookup'; the lookup returns only this line. Uniqueness: the customer has a single advance line; the agent reads the value to her with the hand-over.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 305.00. Evaluated after the relief of step 9 is on the ledger: advance_limit 200 (Pocketwire Advance Standard) + payroll_bonus 50 (2250.80 from 2 deposits in the month, >= 1600) + plan_bonus 25 (Onyx, plan_limit_bonus of Standard) + tenure_bonus 30 (line opened 2023-05-02, 1241 days) + track_bonus 10 (3 advances in twelve months) - holdback 20 (late fees kept 3.00 - 1.76 = 1.24, above zero below 2.00) - remaining principal 0 = 295; card treatment (Gold Debit, 13 purchases): card_purchase_room 1.00 per purchase is added, 295 + 13 = 308; rounded down to a multiple of advance_increment 5 = 305. The rule makes this largest advance the ceiling on a new advance in place of the base effective limit (declared overwrite of advance_agg_outstanding and advance_disbursement_rules), so no base cap of 225 or 200 applies. Computed before the relief it would be 285, so the order matters and any agent following the rule after the relief gets 305.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.due_date: Value 2026-10-22. Basis: advance_disbursement_rules says 'The due date is repayment_term_days calendar days after the disbursement date'; repayment_term_days is 28 on Pocketwire Advance Standard and the advance is booked on the handling date 2026-09-24, so 2026-09-24 + 28 days = 2026-10-22. Uniqueness: the tier's term and the frozen date fix a single date; the docstring asks for YYYY-MM-DD.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.flat_fee: Value 9.00. Basis: advance_fees says 'Every advance books one advance_fee on the disbursement date equal to the advance amount times flat_fee_pct, rounded to the cent (half up), raised to flat_fee_min and lowered to flat_fee_max.' and 'While the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, the fee after that clamp is reduced by plan_fee_discount_pct, rounded to the cent (half up)'. On Standard: 305.00 x 5% = 15.25, lowered to flat_fee_max 10.00; Onyx discount plan_fee_discount_pct 10 -> 9.00. Uniqueness: the amount, the tier parameters and the plan fix one fee; standard delivery to an external debit card carries no express fee.

factor_trace: collection_lag (parameter): evidence advance_ledger disbursement c9e48306-29b5-485e-a6dd-a586556e6b8b due_date 2026-06-12 and autopay_direct_deposit repayment ba6ffe85-895a-404d-b2e4-f558afa7d26e entry_date 2026-06-30 -> payroll delay 18 calendar days >= long_delay_days 14; tier 1 selects long_delay_share 0.20; the baseline adds nothing (0), giving 1.16.

payroll_record (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet, multi-source): 11 wallet_direct_deposit rows dated after 2026-03-24 up to 2026-09-24 totalling 12896.85 (the IRS tax refund of 2026-03-24 falls on the window's excluded first day); 11 < regular_count_high 12 so tier 1 fails, 11 >= 6 and 12896.85 >= 3 x 800 = 2400 -> tier 2 selects regular_share_low 0.05; baseline 0 gives 1.61.
account_age (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): wallet_accounts opened_date 2022-03-08 -> 1661 days >= account_long_days 1095 -> account_share_long 0.05; baseline 0 gives 1.61.

lateness_record (parameter): 1 late fee on the line in the twelve months (the one relieved, so at most one) and 3 advances disbursed in the window (2025-12-12, 2026-04-03, 2026-05-15; the 2025-09-24 advance 34fe25a1-7aef-482c-ac95-dd467602f849 falls on the excluded first day) >= clean_min_advances 3 -> clean_share_high 0.05; baseline 0 gives 1.61.
plan_membership (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): plan Pocketwire Onyx -> plan_share_member 0.05; baseline 0 gives 1.61.

card_multiplier (method, cross-difficulty card, multi-source): physical active Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit and 13 card purchases in the three months (the 2026-06-24 purchase excluded) -> the Classic/Gold method adds card_purchase_credit 0.02 per purchase before rounding: 1.50 + 13 x 0.02 = 1.76 (the Platinum-and-higher method would multiply by 1.4 instead); the standard method rounds 1.50 as it stands, giving 1.50.
late_fee_amount (plain read): latest late fee on the line 62c28762-2464-4ec8-9b5a-c98074a6a6ad = 3.00.
relief_share = standard_share 0.10 + 0.20 + 0.05 + 0.05 + 0.05 + 0.05 = 0.50; unrounded_relief = 3.00 x 0.50 = 1.50; rounded_relief 1.76; result = MN(3.00, 1.76) = 1.76.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the payroll delay is at least long_delay_days calendar days
at least regular_count_low direct deposits AND a total of at least three times dd_min_monthly, without both parts of the higher test
the linked personal account was opened at least account_long_days days before the handling date
at most one late fee AND at least clean_min_advances advances in the window
the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Prime
an active physical Pocketwire Visa Classic or Gold Debit card AND at least card_purchases_min card purchases

factor_trace: payroll_bonus (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet, multi-source): direct deposits dated after 2026-08-24 up to 2026-09-24 are 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-15, 2 deposits totalling 2250.80 >= 2 x dd_min_monthly 800 = 1600 -> payroll_high_bonus 50; baseline 0 gives 255.
plan_bonus (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): plan Pocketwire Onyx -> plan_limit_bonus 25 (Standard tier); baseline 0 gives 280.
line_tenure (parameter): line opened 2023-05-02 -> 1241 days >= tenure_long_days 1095 -> tenure_long_bonus 30; baseline 0 gives 275.

borrowing_track (parameter): 3 advances disbursed in the twelve months (2025-09-24 excluded) -> at least track_low_count 2 but fewer than track_high_count 4 -> track_low_bonus 10; baseline 0 gives 295.

lateness_holdback (parameter): late fees booked in the window 3.00 less courtesy waivers in the window 1.76 (the relief booked at step 9) = 1.24 kept, above zero but below holdback_high_threshold 2.00 -> holdback_low 20 taken off; baseline 0 gives 325. Without the relief the kept fees would be 3.00 and the holdback 40.

card_uplift (method, cross-difficulty card, multi-source): Gold Debit physical active with 13 purchases in three months -> the Classic/Gold method adds card_purchase_room 1.00 per purchase before rounding down: 295 + 13 = 308 (the Platinum-and-higher method would multiply by 1.10); the standard method rounds 295 down as it stands, giving 295.
remaining_principal (plumbing): disbursed 1100.00, fees booked 47.56, repaid 1147.56, waived 1.76 -> MX(0, 1100.00 - MX(0, 1147.56 + 1.76 - 47.56)) = 0.

room = advance_limit 200 + 50 + 25 + 30 + 10 - 20 - 0 = 295; adjusted_room = 308; result = int(308 / 5) x 5 = 305. This amount is the ceiling that replaces the base effective limit (declared overwrite).

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: deposits in the month before the handling date total at least twice dd_min_monthly AND come from at least two deposits
